rules.statement: A Kandyan widow has the right to sell her deceased husband's paraveni property during the minority of their children for the payment of the deceased's debts without obtaining a certificate of curatorship.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore, if a Kandyan widow under the Kandyan Law did not have the right to sell the paraveni or ancestral lands for the payment of the debts of her deceased husband, there was no point in drawing attention to the fact that she had not sold the paraveni lands in preference to the acquired property, or that she had, in fact, sold the acquired lands in which she as widow had a greater personal interest."
